orientation_of.note: orientation_of D: every arc joins adjacent vertices and every edge carries exactly one of its two arcs (D x y (+) D y x), for an arbitrary Boolean D on a simple graph; hence no loop and no digon.

rel_indegree.note: rel_indegree D v = #|[set u | D u v]|: the vertices sending an arc to v (incoming, a loop counts).

proper_indegrees.note: proper_indegrees D: adjacent vertices have different indegrees; a predicate on an arbitrary D that does not assert orientation (a loop relation can be proper).

proper_orientation_bound.note: proper_orientation_bound G k: one D with orientation_of D, proper_indegrees D and every indegree at most k, in this order; 0 on empty and edgeless hosts; monotone in k with the same D.
